capability: Teach a model your taste, one pick at a time
title: Taste, one tick at a time.

hook.picture: Close on the whale typing a long description into a pod. The pod returns a glossy image card, pretty and generic, beside the whale's own sketch.
hook.words: Make it look like my work.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The AI makes pretty pictures. None of them look like mine.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: artist after a night of prompting

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three more descriptions, each longer, and three more generic cards, each the same (every 2 beats, then 1, then half).
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Words can't say what your eye knows.

stakes.body: Hours of describing, and still nothing that looks like your own work.

solution_hint: Pick one of two, again and again.

metaphor.body: The pod offers two small cards, and the whale keeps one. Every pick lands as a tick on a strip, and the next pair drifts toward the whale's own lines and colours.

steps.picture: The pod offers two small cards. The whale flicks one aside and keeps the other, and a tick lands on a strip under the line.
steps.sound: A pluck per keep, a soft tick.

steps.picture: Many quick pairs. Ticks stack on the strip, and the pod's next cards drift toward the whale's own colours and lines.
steps.words: Each pick nudges the next pair closer.
steps.sound: Plucks speeding up, warming in tone.

steps.picture: Push-in: a tired flick keeps the wrong card, and its tick turns raw sienna. The whale finds that tick on the strip and lifts it out.
steps.words: A tired pick? Find it and undo it.
steps.sound: A sour pluck, then the warm pluck returns.

steps.picture: The strip of ticks settles under the line. Every pick is kept in order.

real_case.claim: Illustration only. The orpheum-trainer repo could not be read; this loop of quick either-or picks is drawn from Manu's stated plan for a swipe-style rating trainer.

honest_limit.picture: After many picks the pod only offers cards like last month's work. Learning from past choices narrows toward the past.
honest_limit.words: It learns what you liked, not what's next.

not_this.body: Copying your past is not your taste.

ending_pattern.body: The FELT side-by-side returns, and the pod's card now rhymes with the sketch. The whale then keeps one deliberately odd card.
ending_pattern.callback: Same side-by-side of sketch and pod card as bar 2, the mismatch gone.

end_belief.body: Show your taste with choices, not prompts.
